response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and distributed systems experience with exposure to event-driven architectures and AI-agent tooling, but lacks explicit executive leadership, fintech infrastructure, or regulated AI-system experience. His background is more aligned with hands-on development and open-source contributions than scaling engineering organizations or architecting high-stakes AI systems in fintech.
strengths: Diverse technical expertise across web, mobile, and distributed systems with hands-on experience in event-driven architectures and real-time data processing.
Proven contributions to AI-agent infrastructure (e.g., MCP code generators) and open-source projects like GISCollective, showing initiative in complex domains.
Strong track record in developer tooling, testing, and engineering best practices (TDD, CI/CD, observability) with a focus on production reliability.
concerns: No explicit experience in executive leadership or scaling engineering teams from 10 to 30+ people, a hard requirement for the CTO role.
Lacks demonstrated production experience with multi-agent AI systems in regulated or high-stakes environments (e.g., fintech, credit risk).
Fintech infrastructure familiarity is limited to indirect exposure (e.g., pricing optimization) rather than core systems like credit-limit management or compliance.
